purpose: Teach: 輸出入/顛末/参与/受け手/撤収/マージン/例示/売り出し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、輸出入を自ら手がけられたぞ
lines.en: Your father handled the import and export himself from the very beginning.
lines.style: Measured, respectful cadence. Lifting slightly on the memory, as if turning back through decades. Gentle authority—the voice of someone who watched and learned. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはトラブルの顛末を社員に共有された
lines.en: Yes. He made a point of sharing the details with the staff—even when things went wrong.
lines.style: Steady, affirming. A son recognizing his father's principle. Slight emphasis on the word 'sharing'—pride in the transparency. Quiet but not uncertain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界の参与として声をかけられたぞ
lines.en: Your father was invited to speak as an industry advisor. He had that kind of standing.
lines.style: Soft warmth under the words. A touch of wistfulness—the voice of someone recalling someone no longer here. Thoughtful pauses between phrases. Eyes distant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお客様という受け手を最優先された
lines.en: Yes. He always put the customer—the person receiving the product—first, before anything else.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. Speaking a principle aloud as if to understand it better himself. Steady breath, unhurried. The tone of someone who lived by watching.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、不採算事業の撤収を決断されたぞ
lines.en: Your father made the hard call to shut down the unprofitable lines. He didn't hesitate.
lines.style: Quiet admiration beneath the words. The trace of melancholy for difficult decisions made. Deliberate pacing. The kind of memory that shapes you.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは利益マージンの管理に厳しかった
lines.en: Yes. He was exacting about profit margins—unforgiving about waste. That was one of his strengths.
lines.style: Measured respect. A son acknowledging a father's discipline without flinching. Calm, grounded. The kind of honesty that comes with time and acceptance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内研修で実例を例示されたぞ
lines.en: Your father taught by example in every company training session. He didn't just tell people—he showed them.
lines.style: Nostalgic, with quiet pride underneath. Slower tempo. The warmth of someone who understands now what his father was doing then. A small lift at the end—gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新商品の売り出しを盛大に行われた
lines.en: Yes. He launched new products with real vision and fanfare. He believed in them.
lines.style: Grounded, wise closure. A son speaking the culmination of what he learned. Breath and composure. The last word settles—full stop. No apology in it.
